sn44.3:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhito bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
sn44.3:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.3:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.3:2.1: kinnu kho āvuso sāriputta, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti? avyākataṃ
sn44.3:2.4: kiṃ panāvuso, na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.3:2.7: kinnu kho āvuso, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti? etampi
sn44.3:2.9: “hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti.
sn44.3:2.10: kiṃ panāvuso, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti?
sn44.3:2.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti.
sn44.3:3.1: kinnu kho āvuso, hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno avyākataṃ kho āvuso, etaṃ bhagavatā:
sn44.3:3.3: kiṃ panāvuso, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.3:3.5: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti vadesi.
sn44.3:3.6: ko nu kho āvuso, hetu ko paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
sn44.3:4.1: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho āvuso, rūpagatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.3: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti rūpagatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.4: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti rūpagatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.5: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho āvuso, vedanāgatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.7: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vedanāgatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.8: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti vedanāgatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.9: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho āvuso saññāgatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.11: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti saññāgatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti saññāgatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.13: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho āvuso, saṅkhāragatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.15: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti saṅkhāragatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.16: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti saṅkhāragatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.17: hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti kho āvuso, viññāṇagatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.19: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti viññāṇagatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.20: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti viññāṇagatametaṃ.
sn44.3:4.21: ayaṃ kho āvuso, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena taṃ avyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
